players.product: PCB and substrate process equipment: mechanical through-hole and back-drilling, CO2/UV/ultrafast/cold-laser drilling, lamination, LDI and electrical test for AI-server PCBs and 800G/1.6T optical-module mSAP substrates; TGV, sub-30μm micro-via and ABF thinning/desmear tools for advanced packaging (custom tools on formal orders)

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology IR activity record: 2026-004 (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): demand for high-end AI PCBs — high-layer HDI and N+N high-layer boards for new-generation rack-server compute and switch units, and mSAP substrate-like boards for 800G and 1.6T optical modules — has grown markedly and downstream PCB makers keep investing heavily; orders for all of the company's product lines grew substantially. H1 2026 revenue was RMB 4.98 billion, up 109.29%, and net profit attributable was RMB 957 million, up 263.45%.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 498,492.08 ten-thousand (+109.29%); net profit attributable RMB 95,686.24 ten-thousand (+263.45%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology IR activity record: 2026-004 (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): for AI-server PCBs, its high-torque spindle mechanical drilling and upgraded 3D back-drilling are widely used at customers, enabling volume processing of 31.5:1 aspect-ratio through-holes and 0-4mil back-drilling (CPK above 1.33); its LDI holds line-width variation within 3μm for impedance control within ±7%, and its four-wire testers are gaining share. For 800G/1.6T optical-module substrate-like boards, its cold-laser drilling stably processes 50μm dense micro-vias, its CCD six-axis router reaches ±25μm and its micro-needle tester handles 1.6T module BGA pitch of 150μm or less; these products have passed validation at leading downstream customers and are delivered in volume.
quarterly_data.figure: 31.5:1 aspect ratio; 0-4mil back-drill, CPK above 1.33; LDI within 3μm, impedance ±7%; 50μm micro-vias; ±25μm routing; BGA pitch 150μm or less

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology IR activity record: 2026-004 (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): for 44-layer midplanes and 78-plus-layer orthogonal backplanes required by new AI servers, its ultra-high-aspect-ratio drilling, copper-paste sintered vias and ultra-thick board routing have made substantive progress and can support customer process qualification and samples. For the move of PCBs toward substrates and of substrates toward wafer-like processing driven by 224Gbps-plus single-lane signaling, it has developed sub-30μm micro-vias, through-glass vias (TGV), precision through/blind slotting and flexible ABF thinning and desmear; it is in joint development with leading global compute supply-chain customers and the related custom equipment has received formal orders.

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology IR activity record: 2026-004 (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): as of H1 2026, capacity at the Shenzhen and Xinfeng production bases was substantially higher than at the end of 2025, giving mature volume supply that can keep pace with customers' fast capacity expansion.

Han's CNC Technology.why: Sells drilling, laser, LDI and test equipment to PCB and substrate makers expanding for AI-server PCBs and 800G/1.6T optical-module substrates, and TGV / ABF tools for advanced packaging; its orders track that capacity build-out.
